description.value: Aurora Park Inn & Suites is a highway-side hotel in Dawson Creek, BC, located off Highway 2 about 2.8 km from the airport and near the Encarna Event Center. Rooms and suites include microwaves, minifridges, and TVs, with some featuring kitchenettes or whirlpool tubs, and the property offers a business lounge and a game room with gaming consoles. Free continental breakfast, 24-hour front desk service, coin laundry, and free parking with car plug-ins make it a practical base for travelers passing through northern BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides comprehensive amenity details for this Dawson Creek hotel off Highway 2. Coin laundry, vending machines, and Wi-Fi (listed as 'High speed Internet access') are all explicitly confirmed on the website; the contact page phone number matches the OSM tag exactly. No bike-specific amenities — storage, tools, wash station, or e-bike charging — are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all bike-related criteria remain null.
concerns: Website footer copyright reads '© 2013 KSODESIGN', suggesting the site design has not been updated in many years; content appears functionally current but may not reflect all current amenities.
Website contains a minor misspelling ('Dowson Creek') in one passage — not a material concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational hotel in Dawson Creek with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a 24-hour front desk — a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on northern BC routes.

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated laundry on-site; dry cleaning service also listed as available

Vending machines.detail: Vending machine listed explicitly in the amenities

wow_evidence: continental breakfast, 24-hour front desk service, coin laundry
